newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Stock Exchange posts surplus rise.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Stock Exchange posts surplus rise.

text.p: The Australian Stock Exchange (ASX), currently mutually owned by member firms and individuals, said on Tuesday it posted a surplus after tax and abnormal items of A$19.39 million in the year to June 30, 1996, up from A$14.65 million in 1994/95.
The ASX's operating surplus before tax and abnormal items was A$24.62 million, up from A$22.44 million in 1994/95.
There was tax of A$2.56 million and an abnormal loss of A$2.67 million.
"Operationally, revenue from trading and settlement on the equities market generated most of the increased result," the ASX said.
"The effect of the buoyant market also more than offset a reduction in charges for market information, settlement services and membership that applied for part of the year," the ASX said.
